scope: Built-in synth: waveforms, linear ADSR, voice overload policy, persistence and UI
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none

desktop.note: One earlier run had a single failure that did not reproduce on rerun (output not captured)

verified_behaviors: Independent oscillator x envelope fixture (A4, A/D/S/R) within 2e-6 at blocks 1/64/257/512; defaults reproduce the original sine exactly
Velocity scales linearly; square/saw/triangle shapes at known phases; release continues across the loop boundary
16 voices under overload with quietest-releasing/oldest stealing; stop clears releasing voices; zero intercepted allocations
synth-v1 persistence with exact fields; malformed settings and synth on audio clips refused
Actual QML edits, Undo/Redo, Save/Open, duplicate copies the synth; float export matches an independent triangle x envelope render
limits: Naive aliasing oscillators, no filter or modulation; offline and offscreen checks only.
